# Rack type

A rack type with its Look, in `danbyte/racks/types/<Vendor>/<model>.yaml`. Either an overlay of an upstream `rack-types/` file (`upstream:` plus Danbyte keys) or a complete Danbyte rack type (NetBox rack-type keys plus Danbyte keys) for generic racks upstream doesn't have. Danbyte draws the rack from its own data and the kit its `look.kit` names (export spec §14).

Schema: [`danbyte/schema/rack-type.schema.json`](../../schema/rack-type.schema.json) (danbyte-library/v1).

Files: `danbyte/racks/types/<Vendor>/<model>.yaml`. Start each with the editor line, so VS Code (YAML extension) completes and checks keys as you type:

```yaml
# yaml-language-server: $schema=<relative path to>/danbyte/schema/rack-type.schema.json
```

## Keys

| Key | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `format` | [format](common.md#format) |  | The library format this file is written for. Optional; the tools write it, and a later format will change the value. |
| `upstream` | string (pattern) |  | The NetBox rack-type YAML this overlays, relative to the repository root. Leave it out for a complete Danbyte rack type. |
| `manufacturer` | string |  | NetBox: the manufacturer (complete rack types). |
| `model` | string |  | NetBox: the model name. |
| `slug` | string (pattern) |  | NetBox: URL slug. |
| `description` | string |  | NetBox: short description. |
| `form_factor` | one of `wall-cabinet`, `4-post-frame`, `2-post-frame`, `4-post-cabinet`, `wall-frame`, `wall-frame-vertical`, `wall-cabinet-vertical` |  | NetBox: frame form factor; Danbyte derives the frame from it when `look.frame` is not given. |
| `width` | one of `10`, `19`, `21`, `23` |  | Rail width in inches. |
| `u_height` | integer (1–100) |  | NetBox: height in rack units. |
| `outer_width` | number (0–…) |  | NetBox: outer width in outer_unit. |
| `outer_height` | number (0–…) |  | NetBox: outer height in outer_unit. |
| `outer_depth` | number (0–…) |  | NetBox: outer depth in outer_unit. |
| `outer_unit` | one of `mm`, `in` |  | NetBox: unit of the outer sizes. |
| `weight` | number (0–…) |  | NetBox: weight in weight_unit. |
| `max_weight` | integer (0–…) |  | NetBox: maximum load in weight_unit. |
| `weight_unit` | one of `kg`, `g`, `lb`, `oz` |  | NetBox: unit of weight. |
| `mounting_depth` | integer (0–…) |  | NetBox: mounting depth, mm (Danbyte's rail depth when rail_depth_mm is missing). |
| `starting_unit` | integer (1–…) |  | NetBox: number of the bottom unit. |
| `desc_units` | boolean |  | NetBox: units numbered top to bottom. |
| `comments` | string |  | NetBox: free text (Markdown). |
| `outer_width_mm` | integer (100–3000) |  | Danbyte: outer width, mm. |
| `outer_depth_mm` | integer (100–3000) |  | Danbyte: outer depth, mm. |
| `rail_depth_mm` | integer (0–2000) |  | Danbyte: front rail to rear rail, mm; 0 for a 2-post frame (one rail plane). NetBox `mounting_depth` is read when this is missing. (Danbyte's importer in 0.21 reads 100-2000 and drops other values with a note.) |
| `look` | [look](#look) |  | How the rack is drawn: its kit, doors, panels, roof, base and colour. |
| `meta` | [meta](meta.md) |  | Catalog facts (see meta); category `rack`. |

Example:

```yaml
manufacturer: Generic
model: Generic 42U 600x1000 cabinet
u_height: 42
width: 19
outer_width_mm: 600
outer_depth_mm: 1000
rail_depth_mm: 740
look:
  kit: CABINET
  front_door: perforated
  rear_door: split-perforated
  hinge: left
  side_panels: true
  top: vented
  base: plinth
  colour: black
```

## Definitions

### look

How the rack is drawn: its kit, doors, panels, roof, base and colour.

| Key | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kit` | string |  | The rack kit's name (matched by name, the same vendor's first). |
| `frame` | one of `cabinet`, `4-post`, `2-post`, `wall-cabinet` |  | Overrides the frame taken from `form_factor`. |
| `front_door` | one of `none`, `perforated`, `glass`, `solid`, `split-perforated`, `split-solid` |  |  |
| `rear_door` | one of `none`, `perforated`, `glass`, `solid`, `split-perforated`, `split-solid` |  |  |
| `hinge` | one of `left`, `right` |  |  |
| `side_panels` | boolean |  |  |
| `top` | one of `vented`, `solid`, `fans`, `brush`, `none` |  | Roof variant; `none` for open frames (Danbyte's importer in 0.21 doesn't read `none` yet and drops it with a note). |
| `base` | one of `plinth`, `casters`, `feet`, `plate`, `none` |  | Base variant; `plate` is a 2-post frame's base plate, `none` a wall cabinet's (Danbyte's importer in 0.21 reads plinth, casters and feet only). |
| `colour` | one of `black`, `grey`, `white` or string (pattern) |  | A named colour (black, grey, white) or #rrggbb. |
| `blanking_fill` | boolean |  | Draw blanking panels in empty units. |
